propositions: compact.py exceeds 800 LOC (798) with high cyclomatic complexity and bundles transaction, snapshot reconstruction, and CLI responsibilities in one god module

splitting compact.py into facade (compact.py), transaction engine (compact_txn.py), and rebuild engine (compact_rebuild.py) with one-way dependency graph (compact -> {txn, rebuild}, rebuild -> txn) avoids circular imports

shared snapshot primitives (_build_authorship_ledger, _snapshot_strip_keys, _git_author, _git) must collocate in compact_txn because both _compact_locked and rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log depend on all four

module-level _REBUILD_COUNT and get_rebuild_count must move to compact_rebuild.py where rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log modifies the global, then re-export from compact.py to preserve public import paths
test monkeypatch seams in test_compact_negative.py must repoint to the new module homes (compact_txn._git and lock) because patches on the facade no longer reach the actual execution path

complexity-baseline.json entries for _compact_locked and rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log must shrink or be removed entirely; all three compact.py entries were removed after decomposition put functions below the reporting threshold
